Name: Day Counter
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
A Stardew Valley mod to count days spent, or to count down to a day goal.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]SleepTextLine[/font] (boolean): If true, will show a day counter on the "Your progress has been saved" screen while sleeping.
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]HudPersistent[/font] (boolean): If true, a currency-style HUD will stay on screen. It will only go away if another currency is picked up (walnuts, QI gems)
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]CountdownToDays[/font] (number): If greater than 0, will count down to that many days. If is 0, it is disabled and there will be no counting down.
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]CountdownMode[/font] ([font=Lucida Sans Unicode]days[/font], [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]daysremaining[/font], or [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]daysoutof[/font]): Whether to format the [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]SleepTextLine[/font] as "Day 10", "90 days remaining", or "Day 10/100"
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]HudShowCountDown[/font] (boolean): If true, the hud from [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]HudPersistent[/font] will count down to [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]CountdownToDays[/font]'s value instead of counting up days spent in the game.
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]DayStartedInteractiveNotification[/font] (boolean): If true, will show a textbox on the bottom of the screen when the day starts alerting you of the day.
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]DayStartedNotificationCountdownMode[/font] ([font=Lucida Sans Unicode]day[/font], [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]daysremaining[/font], or [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]daysoutof[/font]): Whether to format the [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]DayStartedInteractiveNotification[/font] as "Started day 10", "90 days remaining", or "Started day 10/100"
[/list]

Manifest.Description: A configurable day counter and countdown mod.
